subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What Feishu card-action payload contract should OpenClaw expose for `form_value`, `input_value`, `option`, `options`, and `name` fields?
rationale: The fix is owner-local, but the exact JSON/text shape becomes agent-visible channel behavior and affects compatibility with existing command-style button actions.

options.title: Refresh structured passthrough
options.body: Review or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43953, preserving simple button commands while exposing form/input/select fields in a documented structured payload.

options.title: Limit scope to form submissions
options.body: Ship only `form_value` pass-through now and leave selector/input shape to a narrower follow-up.

options.title: Keep card actions command-only
options.body: Decline general passthrough and require richer Feishu forms to use a custom plugin-owned callback route.

recommendation.title: Refresh structured passthrough
recommendation.body: Review or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43953, preserving simple button commands while exposing form/input/select fields in a documented structured payload.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark community maintainer, making them the best available owner for the channel behavior contract.
